title: The Blood Money Escrow
logline: A neutral escrow agent holds a massive payout for a mercenary squad, but the syndicate who hired them wants to wipe out the squad to avoid paying the bill.

roles.description: Obsessed with neutrality and protocol; terrified of the money they are currently holding.
Lost half their squad earning this payout, refuses to leave without it.
Smooth, ruthless, tasked with recovering the funds without leaving a paper trail.
A heavily scarred gunship running on fumes and anger.
A neutral zone where neither side is allowed to draw weapons.
A battered private military group trying to make payroll.
Wealthy, paranoid, and violently opposed to paying their debts.

public_situation: A highly publicised local conflict just ended, and a heavily armed mercenary squad is limping back to {system} to collect their hazard pay.
private_truth: The {role:syndicate_cartel} never intended to pay the mercenaries. They are using the escrow period to position a kill team.

beats.public_change: The escrow account officially unlocks, requiring physical decryption keys to transfer the funds.

missions.reason: Needs a neutral pilot to physically collect the decryption keys from the vault and hold them until the hand-over to avoid an ambush.
missions.private_fact: The agent knows the syndicate is planning a hit, but protocol dictates they must proceed with the hand-over anyway.

beats.public_change: Syndicate vessels begin jamming communications around the hand-over site.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to scan the hand-over drop station to confirm the syndicate kill team's presence.
missions.private_fact: The scan officially logs the ambush, satisfying the agent's bureaucratic need for an incident report.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to join the ambush and destroy the mercenary gunship before it can dock.
missions.private_fact: The paymaster will pocket half the escrow themselves if the squad is wiped out quietly.

beats.public_change: The surviving mercenaries broadcast the escrow codes on an open channel.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to rush the decryption keys to a secondary terminal to finalize the transfer before the syndicate hacks it.
missions.private_fact: The captain is badly injured and just wants the funds routed to their surviving crew's families.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the final physical keys at the terminal. They can direct the massive escrow payout to one of two accounts.

options.label: Route the payout to the mercenary families
Freeze the funds back into neutral escrow

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot routes the funds to the mercenary families.
resolutions.summary: The mercenary families get their blood money. The cartel is furious and publicly executes the paymaster for the failure.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stared down the cartel and made sure a dead squad's families got their hazard pay.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot freezes the funds back into neutral escrow.
resolutions.summary: The money remains locked in legal limbo for decades. The mercenaries are left destitute, and the cartel saves face.
The cartel gets its money back and erases all records of the mercenary contract. The surviving mercenaries are hunted down.

loose_threads.detail: The escrow vault's root access logs show an authorized override code that consists entirely of repeating zeros.
The destroyed mercenary gunship's nav computer was completely wiped three hours before the ambush.

radio_hooks: Neutral {role:drop_station} reports 'communications anomalies' affecting financial transfers.
{role:mercenary_company} files formal grievance against anonymous former employer.

voice_direction.escrow_agent: Tight-lipped, precise articulation. Insists on reading full legal disclaimers.
voice_direction.mercenary_captain: Gravelly pitch, deeply bitter. Stresses every harsh consonant.
voice_direction.syndicate_paymaster: Arrogant, casual rhythm. Speaks with a completely relaxed cadence.
